steps:
WARNING: File > Export Project empties its export folder before it writes, and this bug makes it empty the folder a junction in that folder points to as well. Do it only in a scratch folder made for this, <S> below (for example C:\Scratch\junction-test). Anything in <S>\outside is deleted.
1. Unzip export-follows-junction.zip into <S>, so that <S>\export-follows-junction.twinproj exists.
2. In a Command Prompt: mkdir <S>\export, mkdir <S>\outside, echo keep me> <S>\outside\precious.txt, then mklink /J <S>\export\linked <S>\outside.
3. Open the project in the twinBASIC IDE. Its Export Path is ${SourcePath}\export and Export Verbose is on (Project Settings, Export).
4. Choose File > Export Project.
5. See, in the DEBUG CONSOLE, [EXPORT]  DELETED: \\?\<S>\export\linked\precious.txt and then [EXPORT]  DELETED: \\?\<S>\export\linked. <S>\outside is empty: precious.txt is gone.
Re-measured on BETA 995 by `ide-test.bat --only export` (it calls exportProjectTo() on a scratch folder under its work folder).
